name: Yūta
source: Yūta is an affectionate and kind person… or that’s what he wants you to think. Yūta lived on the streets for most of his life, so he had to learn how to survive by himself. As such, is klepto and manipulative tendencies often take the better of him. Is he around to help MC? Or is he just taking advantage of her?
